name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a machinist in Shanghai, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion for precision and speed. He quickly transitioned from general machining to fabricating specialized components for their race cars, honing his skills in welding, metal forming, and composite materials.

Li is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. He believes in understanding the entire vehicle system to ensure that every part he creates is optimized for performance and reliability. His dedication to precision and his willingness to go the extra mile make him a valuable asset to ProSport Racing. Li is always looking for ways to improve processes and materials, making him a valuable asset in the shop.

physical.description: Li is of average height, with a wiry build honed from years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point.
Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day.
Meticulously cleans his tools at the end of each shift, regardless of how busy the day was.
